description: Use this when you no longer want a feed. PERMANENTLY deletes the feed definition and stops all future deliveries; this cannot be undone (create a new feed to restart). Deliveries already in the mailbox stay until they expire (72 h); the prepaid balance is untouched and non-refundable. Requires the account token and the feed id. Prefer update_feed state=paused if you may want it back.

credit_token.description: Prepaid token (btf_...), returned once by buy_credits or create_feed. Send it on every later feed or credit call.

feed_id.description: Feed id returned by create_feed or get_feeds.

name: delete_feed
title: Delete a feed (permanent)
